# Observer Frontend

> A modern healthcare data visualization dashboard for analyzing multimodal clinical encounter data to support telemedicine and in-person consultation research.

The Observer Project is a multimodal clinical encounter data repository that follows FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) principles. This frontend application provides interactive dashboards for visualizing patient-provider interaction data including video, audio, transcripts, EHR data, and audit logs. The platform supports both public analytics and authenticated user experiences, enabling researchers to study healthcare delivery patterns across different modalities and demographic groups.
